{"path":"todo_zai-glm-5.3-flash_01.html","edit_description":"Create a brand-new, single self-contained HTML file implementing a polished Todo app. No external dependencies, no build step — everything inline. Requirements:

STRUCTURE:
- <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, <head> with UTF-8 meta, viewport meta, <title>Todo App</title>, and one embedded <style> block.
- <body> with: an app container card centered on the page containing (1) an <h1> heading, (2) an input row: <input type="text"> for a new todo plus an "Add" button, (3) a filter bar with three buttons: All / Active / Completed (active filter visually highlighted), (4) a <ul> todo list, (5) a footer line showing "<n> items left".
- One embedded <script> block at the end of <body>.

FUNCTIONALITY (vanilla JS):
- Todos stored as an array of objects {id, text, completed} in a JS variable; every mutation re-renders the list and saves the array to localStorage under a key like "todos" (JSON.stringify; JSON.parse with try/catch and fallback to [] when loading).
- Add: clicking the Add button or pressing Enter in the input adds a todo with trimmed text (ignore empty input), then clears the input.
- Toggle complete: clicking a checkbox or the item text toggles completed; completed items get strikethrough (text-decoration: line-through) and muted color.
- Delete: each item has a Delete button that removes that todo.
- Filter: All shows everything; Active shows only completed===false; Completed shows only completed===true. Current filter is kept in a JS variable and applied on every render; filter buttons update their active styling.
- Footer counter shows the number of uncompleted todos.
- Re-render the list from state on every change (simple full re-render is fine).
- Use event listeners and create DOM elements safely (textContent for todo text — do not inject user input via innerHTML).

STYLE (CSS, modern and clean):
- System font stack, a subtle gradient or solid pleasant background, white card with rounded corners and soft box-shadow, comfortable padding and spacing.
- Styled text input and Add button, pill-style filter buttons with active state, list items separated with light borders, Delete button styled subtly (turns red on hover), strikethrough style for completed.
- Responsive enough to look fine on narrow screens (max-width ~480px card)."}
